_written: 2026-11-02, before any AlphaGenome score was retrieved.
model: AlphaGenome API (alphagenome 0.10.0 client), organism human, hg38
interval: 1 Mb (SEQUENCE_LENGTH_1MB) centred on the element midpoint chr19:11089390, the same for every variant

scorers.RNA_SEQ: GeneMaskLFCScorer (recommended): log fold change of predicted RNA over LDLR exons

kept_tracks: biosamples HepG2 (EFO:0001187), liver (UBERON:0002107) and HEK293 (EFO:0001182) when present; RNA_SEQ and CAGE rows restricted to gene LDLR; raw_score and quantile_score saved
primary_score: ag_rna_hepg2 = mean raw RNA_SEQ LFC for LDLR over HepG2 tracks (sign: negative = predicted lower expression)
secondary_scores: ag_rna_liver, ag_cage_hepg2 (LDLR), ag_dnase_hepg2, ag_rna_hek293 / ag_dnase_hek293 if tracks exist; ag_chiptf_hepg2_<TF> for SP1, SP2, KLF family, SREBF1/2, CREB1 and ATF family tracks in HepG2 if present
requests: sequential (max_workers 1) to keep outbound connections minimal (klone policy)
